subject: School Security and Rental Policy Revisions
overview: The Council focused on public school safety following the discovery of an ammunition clip at McGlynn Middle School, voting to review facility rental policies and seeking transparency regarding the costs and ethics of the administration's independent investigation. Members also approved upgrades for city broadcasting equipment to resolve technical issues and requested expanded lead testing on grounds adjacent to the Andrews School.

items.title: Roll Call and Flag Salute
items.summary: The meeting opened with a roll call and the salute to the flag.

items.title: Resolution 18-097: Broadcasting Equipment Upgrades
items.summary: Approved a request to allocate approximately $46,765 for new cameras and microphones in the Alden Chambers and other meeting rooms to resolve long-standing audio-visual quality issues and improve government transparency.

items.title: Resolution 18-098: School Facility Rental Policy Review
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting the School Committee immediately revise rental policies to limit use to school-sponsored events until a safety review is completed and mandatory security personnel are required for all rentals. Discussion highlighted concerns regarding the safety of students and faculty following a security incident at McGlynn Middle School.

items.title: Resolution 18-099: Lead Testing Expansion
items.summary: Approved a motion to expand soil testing for lead at Riverbend Park and behind the Andrews School, specifically requesting surface-level testing between zero and two feet to ensure the safety of play areas used for youth soccer.

items.title: Condolences and Water Quality Investigation
items.summary: Offered sincere condolences to several local families and approved a request for the DPW to investigate reports of discolored and rusty water in the Lawrence Estate neighborhood.

items.title: Petition 18-282: McGlynn Middle School Security Incident
items.summary: Robert Penta addressed the council regarding 'Clipgate,' alleging a conflict of interest in the Mayor's unilateral hiring of a political donor to conduct a personnel review and criticizing the administration's lack of transparency with elected officials.

items.title: Review of School Investigation Costs and Consultant Ethics
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that the administration disclose all expenditures related to the outside investigation into the school security incident and that the City Solicitor provide an ethical opinion on the hiring of the consultant.

items.title: Announcements and Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The Council announced an upcoming meeting regarding the Malden Hospital site development and approved the minutes from the meetings of February 6 and February 20.
